study type: Feasibility and safety study (randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled animal model)
exposure: Intramyocardial delivery of autologous umbilical cord blood mononuclear cells (UCB-MNCs)
outcome: Feasibility of UCB collection and surgical delivery
cohort: 12 juvenile porcine hearts (piglets) that underwent surgical intramyocardial injection of either UCB-MNCs or a placebo.
finding: The study demonstrated that autologous UCB-MNCs can be safely collected and surgically delivered into the right ventricle of juvenile porcine hearts, establishing a foundation for cell-based therapy.
mod_finding: Piglets were born by caesarean section to facilitate umbilical cord blood collection for the study.
